drafts_for_operator.title: Grok Bot phone-call desk
drafts_for_operator.draft_en:
I handed Grok Bot every phone call for a day.

Not a demo. Real businesses. Real holds. Real summaries waiting when I got back.

Elon already said the Bot can dial for you. The part people skip: you stay the publisher. It asks, it waits for your yes, then it dials.

If your calendar is full of "I'll call them later," that later just got a desk that never forgets the follow-up.
drafts_for_operator.video_tip: 10–15s screen recording: calendar of unanswered calls → Grok Bot dialing UI → summary card landing in chat. Hard cut on the first "Approved" tap.

drafts_for_operator.title: Karpathy second brain rewrite
drafts_for_operator.draft_en:
Stop treating Claude like a chat window.

Karpathy's free AI path on GitHub is not another tutorial dump. Seven repos, stacked in order, from how a net learns to agents that research overnight.

The move that actually sticks: point Claude Code at one vault folder and let it be the caretaker. You stop cross-linking by hand. The second brain stops dying of chores.
drafts_for_operator.video_tip: 12s: Obsidian vault chaos → Claude Code caretaker overlay rewriting links → clean graph view. Caption beats: "hand links" / "agent caretaker" / "vault that writes itself".

drafts_for_operator.title: Paste-this trading bot CTA
drafts_for_operator.draft_en:
Paste this into Grok Bot before you sleep.

It walks you through a first trading bot with no code, then keeps watching while you are offline.

I am not promising a return. I am saying the setup that keeps getting shared is the one that runs on its own machine and texts you when something moves.

Steal the prompt before the feed is only this.
drafts_for_operator.video_tip: 8–12s: phone lock screen at night → Grok Bot chat with prompt paste → morning notification "still watching". No fake PnL numbers on screen.

drafts_for_operator.title: Opus motion studio in 8 files
drafts_for_operator.draft_en:
Motion teams are about to hate how thin the stack got.

Eight markdown files. Brief, style, assets, storyboard, motion, sound, delivery, plus the CLAUDE.md that holds the rules.

Drop them next to Opus 5.5 and you get art direction to final render without renting a studio for a week.

Same facts as the posts clearing 20k+: the leverage is the file map, not another plugin.
drafts_for_operator.video_tip: 15s: folder of 8 .md files opening one by one → Opus 5.5 generating a short motion beat → final clip. Beat titles match the file names.

drafts_for_operator.title: Agent memory token cut
drafts_for_operator.draft_en:
Your agent rereads the same twelve files every morning and bills you twice for the same conclusion.

One memory write-up cut a setup from 26,000 tokens per query to 1,800.

Working memory for what it sees now. A layer for what it already decided. Rules for what it must never touch.

If your Claude Code vault still starts blind, that is the first fix.
drafts_for_operator.video_tip: 10s HUD: token counter spinning at 26,000 → slash to 1,800 after a CLAUDE.md / memory layer lands. End on "test the map before you organize the vault".
